subject: maths
question: In a circular race of 950 m length, A and B start with speeds of 18 km/h and 36 km/h, respectively, in the same direction, at the same time, from the same point. After how many seconds will they meet for the first time at the starting point?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the circular track (L) = 950 m

Speed of A (SA) = 18 km/h = 18 × (1000/3600) m/s = 5 m/s

Speed of B (SB) = 36 km/h = 36 × (1000/3600) m/s = 10 m/s

**Formula used:**

Time to meet at the starting point = Length of track / Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed (Sᵣₑₗ) = Speed of B - Speed of A = 10 m/s - 5 m/s = 5 m/s

⇒ Time to meet at the starting point = 950 m / 5 m/s

⇒ Time = 190 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
